open_experiments.title: Verification-cost measurement
open_experiments.notes: Verification/path cost measured at 10²–10⁵ objects in the Stage 2 scaling run (docs/research/stages/v0.2.md); full constraint-budget measurement pending, and the recorded O(m·n) apply debt bounds the current numbers.

open_experiments.title: Merge conflict-detection study
open_experiments.notes: Detection precision/recall on injected conflicts and false-rejection rate on known-clean merges have not been measured.

known_gaps.gap: No addressing or traffic control; connectivity is link-existence only.
No signed transitions or authenticated replicas; peer-sync trust is self-asserted.
No dataplane backends; eBPF/XDP and P4-class remain ADR 0016 extension points.
No DSL; Operations plus the canonical IR are the only authoring surface.
Recorded performance debt: repeated operation application clones the whole network, roughly O(m·n) for m batched operations on n objects.
All measurements are single-machine; binary build reproducibility is unverified.
